label: Avs II system
definition: An AVAST system in which an organism possesses a genome-encoded subtype II locus represented by DefenseFinder with an Avs2A profile.
observations: Avs subtype II branch under AVAST system; distinct from the broader AVAST system, individual Avs2A protein, the individual DefenseFinder Avs_II profile row, unresolved Avs II effector chemistry, Avs I and Avs III through Avs V subtypes, and other phage-defense systems.
